zh: 纽卡斯尔大学（Newcastle University）成立于1834年，是英国著名的公立研究型大学。学校位于英格兰东北部的纽卡斯尔市，其前身为杜伦大学的学院，后来独立成为一所大学。纽卡斯尔大学以其在医学、工程、计算机科学、商业等领域的教学和研究而著称，特别是在再生医学、能源技术等前沿领域具有较强的研究实力。
en: Newcastle University was founded in 1834 and is a famous public research university in the United Kingdom. Located in Newcastle upon Tyne in northeastern England

contact: the university originated as a college of Durham University and later became an independent university. Newcastle University is renowned for its teaching and研究 in medicine
